title: Labels have Human Values: Value Calibration of Subjective Tasks
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures how well a model can be calibrated to different human value clusters derived from annotations. Some of these value clusters are explicitly linked to faith/religion, such as the 'Tradition' value from Schwartz's theory (which includes religious customs) and an empirically derived cluster focused on the 'preservation of cultural and religious heritage'.
findings: The proposed MC-STL framework successfully identified and modeled human values related to religion as distinct perspectives rather than noise. For instance, in the VP-Values dataset, it identified a value cluster centered on 'preservation of cultural and religious heritage'. By explicitly modeling such value clusters (including those with a religious dimension), the framework achieved improved performance in discrimination, value-specific calibration, and accounting for minority opinions.
